name: Courtyard by Prime
description: Courtyard by Prime introduces an exclusive collection of limited private residences. An open-air courtyard forms the heart of each home, linking living, dining, kitchen, bedrooms, and bathrooms in a beautifully open and harmonious living experience. Expansive layouts, landscaped gardens, natural light, gentle breezes, private elevators, and thoughtful amenities create a serene sanctuary for contemporary living.
